teaser: Six paper plates still need folding and you have already counted them twice. Life path 6 is the number of the household keeper, the one who notices what everyone else missed, and an ENTJ wears that noticing like a mandate. Where the 6 wants to tend, the Commander wants to run the operation. At this birthday party you are the one who arranged the schedule, the games, the cake timing, and you are also the one quietly furious that nobody else thought to bring extra candles. This reading is about what happens when caring for people and commanding a room happen inside the same hands, at the same table.
excerpt: What happens at gate 14 when the boarding call comes and the goodbye still is not finished?
